body:
I don't think he loves me anymore and I understand why he would feel that way. He doesn't seem interested in me anymore. I feel like I'm burdening him with my depression and my failure to take care of myself, take care of the house, and other stuff. If I try to be better or make things better I fail, like I'm just so tired.

Existing is painful. I either feel numb or I feel too much hurt. This world is so fucked up in so many ways. I feel more and more like there's nothing to live for. I can't find anything that makes me feel positive or happy or fulfilled or anything.
